_comment: Copy to <company-role>.json and edit. Only targetRole is really required. 'experience'/'projects' entries reference names in ../src/data/work.ts (matched case-insensitively, prefix or substring — so 'LiveAgent' or 'NASES' is enough). Bullets live here (the site data is kept terse); this is where each application's tailoring goes.
targetRole: The exact job title you're applying for
summary: 2-3 sentence pitch tailored to this listing. Omit to use the default summary from src/data/profile.ts.
emphasize: Skill names to render in the accent colour — must match tech names in src/i18n/ui.ts pillars, e.g. Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, PyTorch
skillGroups: Which skill pillars to include, in order. Omit for all. Tags: Platform & Cloud-Native | Product & Architecture | Applied AI / ML
projects: work.ts entry names for the compact Selected Projects strip. Omit for none.
